mu_name_ours: MU's Scroll of Soul Barrier, named Magic Shield here (the user, 2026-10-07: 'rename soul barier to Magic Shield').
mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp loads item group ITEM_ETC number i from Book{i+1:02}.bmd for i up to 19, so number 15 is Book16.bmd; MuMain's _enum.h names it ITEM_SCROLL_OF_SOUL_BARRIER = ITEM_ETC + 15, and OpenMU's VersionSeasonSix/Items/Scrolls.cs:52 names group 15 number 15 the Scroll of Soul Barrier. Season 6 in OpenMU's tree, not 0.75 (docs/mu-scrolls-and-orbs.md SS1).
why_this_one: The wizard's answer to the knight's Orb of Defense, asked for by the user on 2026-09-28: buy the scroll, read it, cast it on himself behind a shield, and stand five minutes under a guard the knight's size. It is a late spell in MU (energy 408 in Season 6) and is brought down to the knight's level on purpose: every requirement, the drop level and the price are the Orb of Defense's, so the two classes meet their guard at the same point in the game. See docs/skills-dw.md.
mesh_note: No geometry of its own. Book01.bmd through Book19.bmd are byte-identical in MuMain's Data/Item -- one md5 across all nineteen -- so this names the one the pipeline has built, as Book02 through Book12 do.

stats.note: A scroll's row, in the shape of Book01's. The numbers are NOT OpenMU's Season 6 row, whose skill asks 408 energy (VersionSeasonSix/SkillsInitializer.cs:134); they are the Orb of Defense's, so that the wizard's guard and the knight's arrive together. Marked as ours.
stats.classes_gladiator: The Magic Gladiator's too, the user's (2026-10-07: 'MG can use shield skill, and also can use Soul barrier'), where MuMain's item.bmd leaves him out.
stats.classes_from: CreateScroll's QualifiedCharacters, the Dark Wizard's line (SoulMasterAndGrandMaster in Season 6 is the wizard's own evolution). Prize.ReadBy refuses the other two.
stats.requires_note: The Orb of Defense's level 6, carried raw as every scroll and orb requirement is (docs/mu-scrolls-and-orbs.md SS4). The same number is on the skill block below, which is what Realm::useItem checks.

skill.note: What the scroll teaches. Read once and gone.
skill.name: Magic Shield
skill.tells: A barrier drawn up behind the shield for five minutes. The better the shield and the keener the wizard, the more of every blow it takes.
skill.tells_from: The skill's own line in sim/skills.cpp, kept letter for letter so the scroll's tooltip and the skill's card say the same thing.
skill.energy_from: None, where Season 6 asks 408: the knight's Defense asks no stat either, and the user asked for the two to stand level at the start of the game.
skill.level_from: Ours: about twice the scroll's drop level, in MU's own order (the user's audit of 2026-10-02: 'currently chars can get end game scroll and orbs pretty fast, remember we have 100% exp rate'). At kExperienceRate 100 a character who never leaves Lorencia reaches level 60 in about a hundred kills and 120 in about sixteen hundred, so MU's own gates -- energy alone on a scroll, the drop level on an orb -- fell within minutes. The energy (or other stat) MU asks is kept beside it.
